text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, I see...
You wish to take care of my daily personal life, is that it?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Precisely! Just the other day, you fell sound asleep in the bath and nearly drowned, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes. I was terribly sleep-deprived from my experiments.
Could it be that you were the one who carried me back to my room that day?
Being a dorm leader must be tough work, ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Your dedication to research is admirable, but neglecting your health is worrisome.
Would you allow us to provide daily lifestyle support within a scope that doesn't disrupt you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I have no complaints about my current situation, mind you.
Well, I have no particular reason to refuse either, so I don't mind.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...So, are these two your co-conspirators?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa...! Unworthy though I may be, this Digi-tan shall fulfill her caretaker duties to the utmost!
I fully intend to commit body and soul to this mission, sir!!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon-san sometimes forgets to eat her meals...
So I thought if there's delicious food, it might make eating something to look forward to.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you, pony-chans.
Having you with me makes this very reassuring.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now, I hereby declare...
the formation of the "Tachyon Daily Life Support Alliance"!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It suits you well, Princess.
Do these garments meet your satisfaction?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... truly fluffy.
One could call this perfect maintenance.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, it doesn't feel bad at all.
There are research findings showing that the smooth texture of clothing increases alpha wave emission, after all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hwah, Tachyon-san...! U-Umm, I haven't moved a single one of your chemicals or equipment...!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Oho, the dust has been cleaned up splendidly.
With this, Cafe won't be nagging me to clean the room anymore.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: (Th-The sacred exchange permitted only between roommates who have spent ages together!? I can see it...! I can clearly visualize ittt! Hyoooeeeeee!!)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I flash-fried the bell peppers to remove the bitterness and seasoned them sweet. How are they...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Splendid! I have always appreciated the Vitamin C content in those green devils, but they are far too bitter.
By the way, I prefer a softer texture.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, then I'll chop them finely next time.
I'll bring you a bento tomorrow as well♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...And that's how it all went down.
One day, I spotted Agnes Tachyon—who was rumored to be leading a healthy life lately—and when I asked for the reason, she shared the story.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
This turned out to be unexpectedly beneficial. My standard of living improved, and my research efficiency went up as well.
...Now then, time to eat, time to eat...
In order to eat her pancakes, Agnes Tachyon reached for the syrup bottle and—
(Glug, glug, glug, pour!! )

It was an amount that looked downright harmful to one's health.
When I asked her if the three Alliance members wouldn't object to this...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ah, about that. The three of them gave me a similar warning before, but—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't hurt anyone, does it?
Even if I'm a little unhealthy, you all take care of me anyway.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let it slide!
At least let me eat as much sugar as I want!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hauu! I-I can't do it! To harden my heart and scold such a pure, innocent being...!!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: She's been working hard on keeping a regular routine, so maybe this much of a reward is okay...?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Good grief, what a troublesome princess.
I am worried about excessive sugar intake, but forcing everything on you would cause stress too, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: —Well, how one consumes sugar is a matter of personal freedom. Even if they hadn't approved, I would have eaten it in secret anyway.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oops, whatever you say will be in vain!
I already have my indulgence pass, after all.
Ahh, nectar of the gods!
It seems that even the members of the Alliance find it impossible to be strict with her. Which seems slightly problematic for caretakers...
